WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(derived_product_cost) as avg_product_cost,
    AVG(CAST(derived_total_cost AS REAL) / CAST(product_price AS REAL)) as ratio_avg
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
    AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL 
    AND product_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) as overall_ratio_avg
  FROM invoice_stats
),
filtered_invoices AS (
  SELECT 
    i.invoice_number,
    i.avg_product_cost,
    i.ratio_avg,
    i.ratio_avg - o.overall_ratio_avg as ratio_diff
  FROM invoice_stats i
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE i.ratio_avg > o.overall_ratio_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_product_cost) as avg_of_avg_cost,
  AVG(ratio_avg) as avg_of_ratios,
  AVG(ratio_diff) as avg_of_diffs
FROM filtered_invoices
